In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. About the Benefits We offer an attractive salary, paid in Saudi Riyals (SAR), the local currency of the KSA. 4c4922327e0333d2.description: About the Role Ultimate Peaks is seeking a Senior Microsoft Infrastructure & Exchange Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role is responsible for the health, security, and continuity of the organization's core Microsoft platforms, including Exchange Server 2019 (on-premises) in a hybrid configuration with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, and associated identity and email-security layers. The position focuses on maintaining reliable corporate messaging, mailbox availability, and identity services within a multi-site business environment. Key Responsibilities Install, configure, administer, and upgrade Microsoft Exchange Server 2019 on-premises, including applying cumulative updates and security patches. Maintain Exchange Hybrid with Microsoft 365, managing configuration, free/busy, cross-premises mail flow, and directory synchronization. Execute mailbox migrations between on-premises and Exchange Online with zero data loss and tested rollback plans. Manage mailbox lifecycle, distribution and shared mailboxes, mail flow, transport rules, connectors, and certificate lifecycle. Design, build, and maintain Database Availability Groups (DAG) for Exchange high availability, including failover testing. Perform advanced Active Directory administration, including domain services, sites, trusts, OU design, delegation, and permissions. Design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimize Group Policy Objects (GPO). Administer and maintain DNS and DHCP infrastructure services. Manage AD replication health, security hardening, and disaster recovery readiness. Administer enterprise email security solutions, including anti-spam, anti-phishing, malware protection, and content filtering. Manage sender authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and investigate email-borne threats. Apply networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VPNs) to ensure messaging and identity security and reachability. Administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Single Sign-On (SSO), coordinating with Information Security. Develop and maintain PowerShell scripting and automation for provisioning, reporting, and bulk operations. Provide senior-level escalation support for messaging, identity, and email security incidents. Maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and as-built diagrams. Ensure messaging and identity business continuity/disaster recovery plans meet requirements, including periodic testing of DAG failover and AD recovery procedures. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent experience with strong certification is acceptable. For a senior role, 8+ years of experience in enterprise Microsoft infrastructure, with 5+ years hands-on with Exchange Server (2016/2019) on-premises and Exchange hybrid with Microsoft 365 in a mid-to-large, multi-site enterprise environment. This includes experience with a full Exchange migration and DAG deployment. A strong mid-senior Saudi national with 6+ years of experience and depth in Active Directory / Entra ID / Microsoft 365, with a commitment to mastering on-premises Exchange, is encouraged to apply and will be supported through a structured certification ramp. Certifications Strongly preferred: MCSE: Messaging or MCSE: Server Infrastructure (or legacy MCITP: Enterprise Messaging). Preferred: Microsoft 365 Certified: Messaging Administrator Associate (MS-203); Enterprise Administrator Expert (MS-102); Identity and Access Administrator (SC-300); Windows Server Hybrid Administrator (AZ-800/AZ-801). Nice-to-have: Email security vendor certification (Proofpoint / Mimecast / Microsoft Defender for Office 365), a networking certification (CCNA-level), and a security baseline (SC-900 / Security+). Work Arrangement This role is based in Riyadh, with on-site and hybrid working arrangements in line with organizational policy. Standard working hours apply, with flexibility to support business needs. The position involves participation in an on-call rotation for critical messaging, identity, and email security incidents, including outside standard working hours. Major changes are executed within approved maintenance windows, typically outside peak hours, with change-management sign-off. Adherence to information security, data-handling, and privileged-access controls is required. Performance Indicators Maintain high availability of messaging services and prevent outages through timely certificate management and patching. Respond to critical messaging and identity incidents within agreed targets, restore services promptly, and document root causes. Deliver mailbox migration waves on schedule with zero data loss and tested rollbacks. Keep systems patched in line with approved security baselines and remediate critical vulnerabilities within required timeframes. Ensure email security with SPF/DKIM/DMARC at enforcement, measured by reduction in delivered phishing/spam with a controlled false-positive rate. Periodically test business continuity and disaster recovery procedures, documenting successful recovery tests. Maintain current technical runbooks and infrastructure documentation for all owned services.

Apply now and be part of a future-focused organization shaping tomorrow’s success. Job Purpose: Support the Technical Inspection function in delivering effective inspection activities for exploitation licenses, ensuring appropriate inspection coverage and compliance with applicable Mining Law and Regulations. The role supports inspection planning, field activities, compliance follow-up, reporting, and continuous improvement of inspection performance. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and Afif, Saudi Arabia, and requires a strong background in the construction sector. Role Overview The HSE Engineer will be responsible for overseeing all health, safety, and environmental aspects across multiple construction sites. This is a fully field-based role, requiring regular presence on site to ensure compliance and maintain a safe working environment for all project teams. Key Responsibilities Conduct regular site inspections to identify potential hazards and ensure adherence to safety protocols. Perform risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies for construction activities. Monitor safety performance and implement corrective actions as needed. Investigate incidents, accidents, and near-misses, and prepare detailed reports. Coordinate with project teams to integrate health, safety, and environmental considerations into project planning and execution. Ensure compliance with all relevant health, safety, and environmental regulations and company policies. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience as an HSE Engineer. Proven experience in road and bridge construction projects is essential. Strong understanding of health, safety, and environmental regulations and best practices. Work Environment This role operates in a dynamic construction environment across various sites in Riyadh and Afif. 4c1ba33ce6c7fd95.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Heart of the House professional for a full-time position in Jeddah. This role is responsible for maintaining cleanliness and order across public and employee areas, ensuring a high standard of presentation and hygiene within the property. Key Responsibilities Clean public and employee restrooms, showers, and glass surfaces. Clean floor surfaces in public and employee areas using designated chemicals, supplies, and equipment. Dust assigned areas and empty trash containers, ashtrays, and ash urns into proper receptacles. Inspect furniture for tears, rips, and stains, and report any damages. Clean and maintain lights, and post caution signs as needed to limit traffic. Contact other departments directly for urgent repairs and respond promptly to requests from guests and other departments. Identify and report preventative or other maintenance issues in public areas or guest rooms. Adhere to all company safety and security policies and procedures, report maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries, and complete required safety training. Ensure a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance, and maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. Welcome and acknowledge guests according to company standards, anticipate and address service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and express genuine appreciation. Communicate professionally and clearly with others. Support team efforts to achieve common goals and ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Ability to move, lift, carry, and place objects weighing up to 55 pounds without assistance, and in excess of 55 pounds with assistance. Capability to push and pull work-related machinery over sloping and uneven surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines to identify defects. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces, and ascend/descend ladders. Stand, sit, kneel, or walk for extended periods across an entire work shift. About the Team and Culture This role is part of The Ritz-Carlton team, a brand within Marriott International, known for creating exceptional guest experiences. The team operates under the "Gold Standards," which guide daily operations and emphasize creativity, thoughtfulness, and compassion. As a member of this team, you will learn and exemplify these standards, including the Employee Promise, Credo, and Service Values, contributing to a culture that prioritizes excellence in guest care and comfort. Work Environment The position is based in Jeddah and is a full-time role. It involves working in a dynamic hospitality environment where adherence to established service standards and teamwork are essential. The Ritz-Carlton fosters a supportive environment where employees are encouraged to develop professionally and take pride in their work. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this opportunity to join Marriott International and The Ritz-Carlton team.

4c1bc1630712bd26.description: About Tarabut Holding Limited Tarabut is a regulated open banking platform in the Middle East, holding licenses from SAMA in Saudi Arabia, CBUAE in the UAE, and CBB in Bahrain. The company connects banks, lenders, and fintechs to financial data and payments infrastructure, while also developing embedded finance distribution across the region, including an SME lending business in Saudi Arabia. Role Overview: Project Manager, Bank Programmes Tarabut is seeking a Project Manager to oversee bank programmes within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing two to three key programmes concurrently, collaborating with tier-1 Saudi banks to facilitate rapid product deployment. The Project Manager will engage with stakeholders from the C-suite to integration managers, manage client relationships, and work with product and commercial teams to expand these accounts. This position is based in Ar Riyad (Riyadh) and reports to the Chief Strategy Officer, with regular travel required to Jeddah and Bahrain. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain comprehensive programme plans, including milestones, dependencies, decisions, and risks. Serve as the primary point of contact for bank counterparties, owning client relationships. Organize and lead weekly meetings with bank counterparties, including working groups and steering committees, ensuring actions are closed. Address programme delays by investigating details and ensuring resolution. Identify opportunities for programme expansion and translate them into scoped follow-on work. Manage approval-linked milestones and go-live gates in coordination with the compliance team. Identify and escalate risks early, providing potential solutions. First 90 Days Objectives Establish one programme plan and weekly cadence, adopted by all counterparties. Successfully deliver the first inherited bank milestone on schedule. Implement a RAID log that is trusted by both internal and external teams. Qualifications and Experience 6-10 years of experience in project management. Delivery experience with banks in the GCC region. Domain experience in open banking, lending, or payments. Established relationships within GCC banks. Proficiency with AI tooling and current understanding of LLM capabilities, applying them to accelerate programme execution while discerning when human review is necessary. Experience guiding a regulated product through go-live with SAMA or CBB supervised institutions. Work Location This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires regular travel to Jeddah and Bahrain.

4c2de66d99376a61.description: About the Role AlKhalejiah is seeking a Logistics & Fleet Operations Manager to lead end-to-end logistics operations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role primarily focuses on transportation, distribution, and fleet management, with additional oversight of warehousing and inventory operations. The manager will ensure reliable food logistics services through effective operational systems, cost control, resource planning, and continuous performance improvement. Key Responsibilities Manage daily transportation and distribution, including route planning, delivery schedules, vehicle allocation, and capacity based on demand. Oversee fleet availability, preventive maintenance, repairs, and vehicle replacement planning, while monitoring fuel consumption, mileage, downtime, and driver productivity. Manage third-party transport providers, monitoring service quality, cost, and contractual performance. Lead the effective use and improvement of ERP, TMS, WMS, and fleet tracking platforms, ensuring accurate operational data and improving workflows with Finance and IT. Prepare and manage budgets for transportation, fleet, distribution, and warehousing, analyzing costs and identifying improvement opportunities. Control fuel, maintenance, manpower, subcontractor, and warehouse operating costs, reviewing budget variances and implementing corrective actions. Ensure appropriate handling, storage, and transportation of food products, including chilled and frozen goods, maintaining temperature controls, hygiene standards, and product traceability. Oversee receiving, storage, picking, dispatch, and inventory control activities, ensuring inventory accuracy through stock counts and reconciliations. Lead transport, fleet, distribution, and warehouse teams, establishing clear responsibilities and performance targets. Monitor KPIs covering delivery timeliness, fleet utilization, operating costs, inventory accuracy, and product losses, presenting regular performance reports to management. Operational Systems and Data Management The role involves leading the effective use and improvement of critical operational systems such as ERP, Transport Management Systems (TMS), Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and fleet tracking platforms. This includes ensuring accurate operational data across all records, collaborating with Finance, IT, and system providers to enhance workflows and reporting, and establishing dashboards for performance visibility. Training teams on system usage and enforcing consistent operational processes are also key aspects. Food Logistics and Cold Chain Management A critical component of this role is ensuring the appropriate handling, storage, and transportation of food products, including chilled and frozen goods. This involves maintaining strict temperature controls, hygiene standards, product traceability, and cold chain integrity. The manager will monitor temperature records, address deviations, and coordinate with Quality teams to uphold food safety standards throughout the storage and distribution processes. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in logistics and fleet operations management. Proven experience in managing transportation, distribution, and warehousing. Familiarity with ERP, TMS, WMS, and fleet tracking platforms. Strong understanding of cost control and operational efficiency principles. Experience in food logistics and cold chain management is essential. Demonstrated leadership and performance management skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires coordination with various internal teams, external stakeholders, and third-party providers to ensure seamless logistics operations and high service levels.

4c799c3b05c38615.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ساس البلد للتشغيل والصيانة عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التشغيل والصيانة للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، مع الالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب التقدم، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. فهم عميق لبرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. معرفة ببرامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية والصيانة الوقائية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة ساس البلد للتشغيل والصيانة. المهارات الشخصية مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. القدرة على متابعة التطورات التقنية وتطبيقها. مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على إدارة المشاريع. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة ساس البلد للتشغيل والصيانة، يرجى التقديم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

4c7ba9eff7cd11ce.description: About the Role Premium Food Company is seeking a Projects Manager Restaurants to oversee restaurant construction and fit-out projects. This full-time role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and involves managing projects from initial concept design through to final handover, ensuring adherence to scope, budget, and timelines. The Projects Manager will also support company expansion initiatives and coordinate facilities and maintenance activities to ensure operational readiness. Key Responsibilities Lead multiple restaurant projects, overseeing design, tendering processes, construction, and handover to Operations. Develop comprehensive project plans, schedules, and budgets, and monitor progress while managing changes to scope, cost, and timelines. Review design packages, tender documents, cost estimates, and contractor bids to ensure accuracy and compliance. Coordinate effectively with consultants, contractors, kitchen equipment suppliers, and internal stakeholders throughout the entire project lifecycle. Conduct regular site inspections to verify quality, compliance with regulations, and alignment with approved designs and specifications. Manage procurement activities, review contracts, and monitor the performance of suppliers and contractors. Identify potential project risks, resolve issues promptly, and escalate any budget, schedule, or specification discrepancies to management. Standardize finishing materials and Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) specifications to enhance durability and reduce long-term maintenance costs. Coordinate restaurant facilities maintenance, including preventive maintenance schedules, necessary repairs, contractor activities, and cost control measures. Support new location assessments, lease reviews, and strategic expansion planning for the company. Ensure the completion of snagging, testing, commissioning, and all required handover documentation. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess a minimum of 10 years of experience in project management, specifically within restaurant construction and fit-out projects. A proven track record of managing complex projects from concept to completion is essential. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. 4c83e76014902550.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخليج العربي للصيانة والمقاولات عن فني هندسة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يساهم هذا الدور في دعم أنشطة الهندسة الميكانيكية، بدءًا من البحث والتصميم وصولاً إلى الإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساعدة في أبحاث الهندسة الميكانيكية وتصميم المعدات والنظم. دعم أنشطة الإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة للمعدات والنظم. المساهمة في تطوير نظريات جديدة وتحسين الأساليب الحالية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. تقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة ضمن عملية التصميم الشاملة. دعم المشاريع الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم. إعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم في أعمال صيانة النظم وتصليحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية أو ما يعادله. فهم جيد لمبادئ الهندسة الميكانيكية وتطبيقاتها. القدرة على المساعدة في تصميم المعدات والنظم. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات والتحليل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق متعدد التخصصات. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. مهارات تواصل فعالة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم العمليات الهندسية والصيانة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

4c986a1d1e38c8e7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن سكرتير تنفيذي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تقديم الدعم الإداري والتنظيمي للمدير أو الرئيس، مما يضمن سير العمليات اليومية بسلاسة وفعالية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنظيم وتنسيق مواعيد المدير/الرئيس وتذكيره بها بشكل مستمر. التعامل مع الاستفسارات الواردة والرد عليها، بالإضافة إلى استلام وتوصيل البريد والمراسلات للمدير/الرئيس. إعداد المذكرات الدورية والمراسلات المتعلقة بعمل الوحدات التنظيمية الداخلية. إجراء المراسلات الاعتيادية مع الجهات الخارجية، والتأكد من توقيعها من المدير/الرئيس، ثم توزيعها. حضور الاجتماعات وتسجيل محاضرها وتحريرها بدقة. حفظ وتصنيف الوثائق والملفات المتعلقة بأعمال المدير/الرئيس بطريقة منظمة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها لضمان سهولة الرجوع إليها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال السكرتارية التنفيذية أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على تنظيم المهام المتعددة وإدارة الوقت بفعالية. مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية ممتازة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة مهنية داعمة في شركة معين للموارد البشرية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال مراحل المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

4ca19c1b0bf5fa1f.description: About the Internship AWS EMEA SARL (Saudi Arabia Branch) is offering an internship for a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This 3-month, full-time internship (40 hours per week) is scheduled to begin in summer 2027 and is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs. Role Overview As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern, you will gain hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure supporting Amazon's global data centers. The role involves providing technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers, ensuring mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate with 100% availability. This position requires daily on-site presence, typically Sunday through Thursday day schedules. Full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays; candidates should be prepared for this commitment upon transitioning to a full-time position. Key Responsibilities Maintain mechanical and electrical equipment. Assist with root cause analysis of equipment failures. Troubleshoot facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment. Utilize internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows. Interact with third-party vendors and contractors working on site. Equipment Exposure Interns will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers, maintaining better than **** uptime. This includes, but is not limited to: Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear. Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs). Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers. Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs). Building automation systems. Required Skills and Qualifications This internship is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Critical skills for success include prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly to situations. The role involves both independent work and team-based collaboration. About the Team The AWS Infrastructure Services team is responsible for the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure, including data centers and all supporting equipment. Interns will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, and operations managers, collaborating across AWS to maintain high standards for safety and security while ensuring continuous access to services for customers.

4ccbdd9f8c542af3.description: About the Internship Amazon is seeking a Physical Security Specialist Intern to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, 12-week internship designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns demonstrating strong performance may be considered for a full-time Security Specialist position, subject to available roles and business needs. The role is based at a data center facility in a remote location without public transportation access, requiring a valid driving license and personal transportation for daily commute. Role Overview The Security Specialist Intern will work within the Data Center Security team at Amazon Web Services (AWS), focusing on the physical security operations of Amazon's data centers. This hands-on role involves direct engagement with people, systems, and processes to maintain critical infrastructure safety. The intern will contribute to operational security excellence, prepare reports and presentations, and communicate with management regarding physical security operations. This role does not involve cybersecurity. Key Responsibilities Coordinate with vendors involved in new security construction, repairs, daily security operations, patrols, and planning. Analyze security metrics and data to identify trends and recommend improvements. Suggest enhancements for electronic surveillance systems and access controls. Assist in developing and delivering guidance to data center occupants on reducing false alarms. Prepare reports and presentations on the status of physical security operations for management. Support the planning and coordination of security-related projects. Aid in incident documentation and follow-up processes. Qualifications and Requirements 0-1 year of experience. Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours per week) internship for 12 consecutive weeks. Availability to report to work on-site daily, typically Sunday through Thursday. 4ce1a58bb6a50887.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التفاعل الذكي للاتصالات عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على وضع وتحديد مؤشرات ومعايير الأداء والجودة في خدمة العملاء، والمشاركة في تطوير الإجراءات والبرامج التي تهدف إلى تعظيم جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء. كما يتضمن الدور تحليل نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء ورضاهم. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الأداء والجودة في خدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة، وضمان المتابعة المستمرة. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما يشمل تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام والرد على طلباتهم واستفساراتهم بفعالية وكفاءة ومهنية، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. تطوير برامج متقدمة ومبادرات إبداعية لضمان تحقيق ما يفوق توقعات واحتياجات المتعاملين من حيث جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، بهدف بناء نموذج متكامل لخدمة العملاء. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نتائج تقييم رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع الخطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتنسيق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل أخصائي خدمة العملاء ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحسين وتطوير تجربة العملاء بشكل مستمر.

4c3ad007944a1862.description: Job Purpose To lead the store team in delivering exceptional Patchi guest experience and achieving sales and profitability objectives. Review cleaning, temperature, wastage and equipment records and correct incomplete checks or deviations promptly. Maintain inspection readiness and follow up on food safety, hygiene and municipality audit findings with the relevant departments. Maintain store emergency readiness and report accidents, hazards, security incidents and serious guest or employee concerns promptly. Arabic speaker with good English language Knowledge of food safety and hygiene practices.

Evaluate and manage risks associated with opportunities, contractual commitments, project execution, and third-party content, promoting a culture where safety, integrity, quality, and customer commitments are non-negotiable. 4cfc90bf426a08ba.description: About The Role Müller's Solutions is looking for a senior SAP Supply Chain and Procurement consultant to own the Source-to-Pay and inventory management workstream on a S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition implementation for a major trading group in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This is a broad, senior generalist role — you will be the single specialist covering procurement, supplier management, and core inventory processes across 4 legal entities. You will work primarily offshore, joining the client onsite in Riyadh for key Fit-to-Standard workshops, UAT, and go-live. You'll partner closely with the Finance and Integration workstreams, since procurement processes touch both heavily in this engagement. What You'll Own — Fit-to-Standard workshops covering procurement and inventory processes, translating client requirements into standard S/4HANA Cloud configuration. — End-to-end configuration of purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and goods receipt workflows. — Supplier master data setup, purchasing contracts, and supplier evaluation and performance monitoring. — Core inventory and stock management configuration across all 4 legal entities. — The integration design touchpoints between Procurement (MM) and Finance (FI), working closely with the Finance Lead. — Data migration scope for vendor master records and open purchase orders, in coordination with the Data Migration Consultant. — End-user training delivery for procurement and inventory users during the Deploy phase. — 5+ years of SAP MM / Supply Chain consulting experience, with at least one full-cycle implementation as lead consultant. — Hands-on configuration experience in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition procurement processes. — Strong, demonstrable knowledge of the full Source-to-Pay process — from requisition through invoice settlement. — Practical experience with basic warehouse and inventory management configuration. — Comfort working independently across a broad scope, without a large team of specialists to lean on. — Solid understanding of MM-FI integration points: goods receipt, invoice verification, accruals. Preferred — Prior project experience in the KSA market, with familiarity around local procurement and supplier practices. — Exposure to intercompany stock transfer and subcontracting processes. — Working knowledge of Arabic, written or spoken. — Experience in trading, distribution, or bulk commodities client environments.

4c57d7b5a92f058d.description: JASARA PMC is currently seeking an experienced Project Manager - External Works to join our dynamic team. This role focuses on managing the planning, design, and execution of external works encompassing civil general assets and landscape projects within our comprehensive social infrastructure programs supporting Vision 2030. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading multi-disciplinary teams to deliver high-quality external works projects on time, within budget, and meeting client standards and regulatory requirements. You will collaborate closely with clients, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure alignment with project objectives and seamless project delivery. Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Landscape Architecture, or related field. Minimum of 10 years experience in project management and delivery of heavy civil projects. Proven experience as a Project Manager managing external works including civil general assets and landscape projects. Strong knowledge of civil infrastructure, landscaping design, and construction processes. Experience managing multi-disciplinary project teams and coordinating with consultants and contractors. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage project budgets, schedules, and risks effectively. Familiarity with local codes, standards, and environmental regulations. Proven track record of delivering projects on time and within budget. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities under pressure. Project management certification (e.g., PMP) is highly desirable.

4c98f85e7a20b1ff.description: Our client is building infrastructure for sovereign AI, the kind of technology that shapes how nations, enterprises, and people experience intelligence. We need someone who can translate that into a social presence that actually lands. Not just someone who can schedule posts. Someone who gets it. What you'll own: Full ownership of client's social channels: strategy, content, cadence, and community across LinkedIn, X, and wherever the conversation is happening. Knowing what to post, when, and why. You follow the AI and tech news cycle closely and you know how to move fast when something matters. Building content that speaks to both Western tech audiences and the Middle East, two markets we operate in seriously, not as an afterthought Working with our comms, product, and exec team to turn complex ideas into content that's sharp, accessible, and true to who we are. Managing content calendars, coordinating assets, and keeping the pipeline moving, especially around launches, events, and announcements Tracking performance and being honest about what's working and what isn't. We make decisions based on data, not vibes Who are you? You live in the tech and AI space online, not just as a job, but because you're genuinely curious about it You understand the cultural nuances of both MENA and Western audiences and you know those aren't the same playbook You write well in English and Arabic fluency is a genuine plus, not a checkbox You have at least 4 to 6 years of social media experience, ideally in B2B tech, AI, or enterprise SaaS. You've done this before and you have the receipts You're comfortable with ambiguity and working across time zones. We're a distributed team and we move fast You're equally comfortable setting the strategy and executing on it. you take a brief and run with it Bonus points: Arabic fluency AI/ML literacy Enterprise SaaS background Experience with GCC markets Basic visual/content creation skills Startup or scale-up experience What working here looks like? Fully remote. You'll report to Chief Ethics Advisor and work closely day to day with Head of Communications. This is a role with real ownership and what you build will be seen. We're a small, serious team. We do expect you to show up with ideas, move quickly, and care about the work.
